The green bars represent 2-Fbit and the blue bars represent 4-Fbit. The green bars for 2-Fbit range approximately from 0.000010 to 0.000055, while the blue bars for 4-Fbit range approximately from 0.000009 to 0.000110. The diagram displays a general upward trend in sensitivity as the block index increases for both 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices for two categories, 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit. The horizontal axis represents the block index, which ranges from 0 to 63, with no specified units or scale type. The vertical axis represents sensitivity, with a logarithmic scale spanning from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-4}$. The chart features two sets of bars, one for 2-Fbit in green and one for 4-Fbit in blue. The 2-Fbit bars have approximate values ranging from around $7 \times 10^{-6}$ to $2 \times 10^{-5}$, with the shortest bar at block index 10 and the tallest at block index 2. The 4-Fbit bars have approximate values ranging from around $7 \times 10^{-6}$ to $1 \times 10^{-4}$, with the shortest bar at block index 13 and the tallest at block index 63. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The block indices are not grouped or stacked; instead, each category has its own set of bars, allowing for a direct comparison between the two.
